Every notebook is sewn in signatures of sixteen pages, so it opens flat on the first day and still opens flat on the last. The dot grid is printed at 5 mm in a grey light enough to disappear when you write over it.
Keep it away from damp. If a page tears, the stitching holds; trim it with a knife along the fold. Cloth covers take a damp cloth, not a wash.
Ink sits on the paper instead of sinking in. My fine nib finally behaves.
Third one this year. Lay-flat means I can write on the train with one hand.
Lovely paper. I wish the ribbon was a touch longer, but that is the whole complaint.
